reviews.text: 为什么不让我修改？？ 我玩个单机游戏还不能修改数据这合理吗？

《巨人杀手：暗黑之潮》是一款偏类幸存者玩法的俯视角Roguelite动作游戏。游戏的画面很有暗黑风格，技能演出效果非常优秀。玩家需要依靠神祗的力量获得成长，在游戏中完成一系列的目标从而引出最终的巨人，击败巨人来获得胜利。 游戏目前刚刚以EA阶段发售，内容还较为单薄，内容较少。并且有明显的难度平衡性问题，算是当下的主要问题，尚需后续的更新修复和内容填充。 [h1]游戏的画面是目前最大的亮点[/h1] 本作游戏最吸引我的地方就是游戏的画面，我也是被商店页面的演示内容所吸引。游戏颇有暗黑破坏神的画面风格，3D的暗黑风让我欲罢不能。游戏中的招式释放的效果也非常优秀，当玩家的战斗养成成型之后整个画面技能释放让人眼花缭乱，非常炫酷。 游戏中玩家可以选择多个不同的人物装备不同的武器，每个人物都有独特的攻击方式和属性，不同的武器则拥有不同的主动技能，在战斗中玩家除了传统的类幸存者玩法的自动攻击之外，还拥有两个主动技能，一个便是主武器的主动攻击技能，另一个则是位移技能，一个突刺技能。游戏中部分攻击招式是有攻击方向的，比如初始的战士角色，攻击便是攻击面向的方向，并且可以设置根据最近敌人的方向进行调整，游玩起来还是很方便的。但是如果玩家面对的敌人数量比较多，并且玩家有自己的节奏的话建议关闭这个自动朝向功能。 [h1]利用神祗能力提升局内战斗力[/h1] 本作游戏的玩法偏向于类幸存者，游戏中玩家通过击杀敌人，并拾取敌人死亡后掉落的经验值来提升等级。主角等级的提升可以获得新的技能成长。而玩家也可以在人物成长和其他神祗技能中进行选择。不同的神祗可以有不同方向的主动技能和各种属性。例如雷神索尔，就可以增加人物攻击带有的雷电属性，也可以学习他其他的雷电系技能。玩家可以通过通关关卡来解锁更多的神祗。不过目前游戏的版本比较低，神祗的数量还比较少，游戏可能会后期进行更新，扩充更多的人物和更多的神祗技能。而当人物提升到一定等级的时候，还会有分支职业路线可选，区分人物当前战斗中的技能方向。 [h1]完成目标召唤巨人[/h1] 本作游戏比起其他的传统类幸存者游戏的胜利机制有所改变，玩家不仅仅需要让人物存活一定时间，还需要在期间内完成一定的目标数量，最终召唤巨人，并成功杀死巨人。游戏中出现的任务目标是比较随机的，玩家有可能在多个目标中进行选择，选择更容易完成的目标，可以更快地见到巨人，也可以让玩家的技能更快的成型。不同难度下，玩家需要完成的目标数量也有所不同，同时给予的时间也会有差别。而高难度下目标不仅完成效率较低，最终的巨人也是比较刮痧，很难杀死。 [h1]高难度下游戏略显硬核[/h1] 本作游戏目前难度平衡性做的有点差，当然也跟游戏目前还处于EA阶段有很大的关系，很多内容尚需修正以及更改。目前游戏在简单难度下通关还算容易，并不会卡关。但是随着玩家选择关卡的难度提升，即便游戏赋予玩家一定的局外成长能力，但是想要突破普通难度以上的关卡仍感觉困难，甚至有点运气成分。并且因为游戏目前的神祗人物技能数量较少，玩家能够走的流派也比较少，因此才会有一些难度上的硬核感觉。如果游戏未来能够更新更多的技能和神祗的话，可能就会有更多的流派出现，提供给玩家更多的选择。 [h1][quote=] [table] [tr] [th] 欢迎关注 [b][u][i]U_U鉴赏家培养计划[/i][/u][/b][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th] 关注U_U鉴赏家，开启精彩游戏之旅。 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote][/h1]

[h1] 北欧题材撞上俯视角肉鸽，坏了！硬核浪漫和割草快感它都有了。 [/h1] 要是说近几年最火的游戏类型是什么，那么肉鸽游戏肯定要拿出来说一说了，自从吸血鬼幸存者爆火，各种各样的肉鸽游戏层出不穷，无论是骰子肉鸽，卡牌肉鸽还是动作肉鸽，真的是让哥们挑花了眼，而巨人杀手：暗黑之潮这款游戏，有点不一样，它的题材居然是以北欧神话作为背景，我们将要扮演一个被诅咒的英雄，去杀穿荷尔海姆！（怎么感觉有点像黑帝斯啊？）接下来话不多说，进入正题吧。 [h1][quote=] [table] [tr] [th] 欢迎关注 [b][u][i]U_U鉴赏家培养计划[/i][/u][/b][/th] [/tr] [tr] [th] 关注U_U鉴赏家，开启精彩游戏之旅。 [/th] [/tr] [/table] [/quote][/h1] [h1] 不是哥们？这就是你的暗黑美学吗？ [/h1] 其实肉鸽题材的游戏，玩法都大差不差，就是不断的成长，然后越来越爽，在游戏的开头，我们可以选择不同的英雄角色，像什么法师啊，狂战士啊或者弓箭手啊，反正应有尽有，每个英雄的技能都不一样，进阶特性肯定也会有所差距，不过对我来说，就是换种形式的爽快而已。因为是动作类的肉鸽游戏，所以技能的组合挺重要的，boss战也比较考验你的操作。 接下来再讲讲它的美术风格，因为是北欧题材，所以画风是比较硬核的，同时游戏的主基调是黑暗风格，因为我们要杀穿的可是北欧神话中的冥界，赫尔海姆啊！所以我才会在标题中称它为暗黑美学，游戏对于冥界的氛围渲染是真的不错，特别是boss战的视听效果，这个价位还挺香的。 [h1] 上手轻松是轻松，但是玩多了就有点~ [/h1] 作为一款肉鸽游戏，上手还是挺轻松的，游戏的技能机制并不复杂，但是缺点就是，后期的内容重复性比较高，玩多了容易腻，不过这也是肉鸽游戏的常态，毕竟爽太多了总是要进入圣人模式的，游戏目前还在EA阶段，我还挺期待它的完整版的。 [h1] 结尾的碎碎念 [/h1] 如果说你是暗黑风格的爱好者，那么这款游戏肯定适合你，它融合了北欧神话的硬核浪漫和肉鸽游戏的割草爽感。但是缺点就是重复性太高了，后期玩着比较乏力吧，不过它还在EA阶段，倒是可以等等后续的更新，这个北欧神话的框架做的还是挺不错的，后续不断的填充内容，肯定会越来越好。

离谱的平衡性，对build要求极高，许多流派高难度碰都没法碰。而且最后一张图的难度非常高，小怪肉的同时数量还异常多。最后就是，那个转镜子任务是真的离谱，来点提示，或者少转两下，疯狂难度一群小怪和BOSS的同时，这个任务还废了一大堆时间，转了6分钟硬是没转成功，时间结束失败了。（好消息，镜子转明白了，转明白以后一分钟就过去了。坏消息，疯狂难度最后一关的陷阱关卡根本没法玩，各种远程伤害，地面上还全是陷阱，你一踩就扣血，走位都不知道该怎么走位。） 想和官方说一下，一个类似幸存者游戏，不应当重点是怎么提高游戏难度，而是应该怎么让玩家爽。为了平衡性，不应该是什么强削弱什么，而是什么弱，加强什么。为什么玩家只玩特定build，一方面确实那种build很厉害，但另一方面，肯定是因为其他build根本玩不了。 最新消息，历经千辛万苦，终于通过最后一张图的疯狂难度了，攻略思路可以移步到小黑盒来社区看看。

I find myself confused about this one. It has all the makings of a fun and engaging survivors-like game, with interesting characters, upgrades, abilities, graphics, a "deep enough" meta-progression, interesting boss encounters... But for some reason, it's putting me to sleep. For my 2.6 hours of playtime, I only progressed to the second map. Not because it's especially challenging or anything, but because every run I attempted I found myself falling asleep. After multiple attempts, I've just come to the conclusion that this game will just put me to sleep. It took a lot of effort to see the first world through. The first two maps are barren (mostly feature-less), open arenas and the challenges are similar to Deep Rock survivors. except the landscape or intensity aren't there to make them more interesting or engaging. I really want to like this game, especially since I only heard good things, and I appreciate its quality. I'm putting this here in case anyone else is curious about something to contrast the positive reviews (I was). Maybe it's just me. I don't want to give this a negative recommendation, but I will likely never play this again.

Didn't click for me. Graphics are good (I dislike the pixelated trend in this genre), neat setting, a fair amount of builds, some minor original parts, decent metaprogression. However, I found the core gameplay simply boring. Now, typically early runs in this genre are always a bit boring, until you boost the difficulty. Here, even after I did that until I died frequently, I still found the runs boring, right until the moment I died. Can't really put my finger on exactly why; there's a fair amount of different things to do within a run. I guess maybe partly because the game itself feels a bit clunky; the skills don't feel too impactful; and I never looked forward to try out a particular combo. I only played a few hours, but as I considered all of those boring, can't recommend. Still, there are some upsides, so if you're heavily into this genre, could be worth a try.

This one just doesn't do it for me. I've played a lot of games in the bullet heaven/bullet hell genre, and this feels surprisingly devoid of substance. While it looks polished enough on the surface, it rarely does anything that sets it apart from its competitors. Instead, it comes across as derivative without offering a compelling reason to invest your time. The progression system lacks that satisfying "one more run" feeling that keeps the genre engaging. While there are opportunities to specialize builds and optimize your playstyle, the available options feel underdeveloped and never evolve into anything particularly exciting. Replayability is also limited. The characters are by-the-book, build diversity is thin, and run-to-run variance isn't strong enough to keep things feeling fresh. As a result, the game struggles to maintain interest beyond the initial hours and doesn't have much staying power.

There's upsides, like it's actually difficult compared to other similar games, the theme and presentation are cool and satisfying, there's nice variation in maps and characters... But the downside is HUGE, and I don't think I can recommend it over other similar games. The game just never gets crazy. Doesn't matter how lucky you get, if you stack buffs on a single mechanic or try to spam as many different mechanics as possible... every run just feels like you're basic attacking for its entirety. With maybe a slightly cooler effect or two later on. You're kinda doing the same stuff, the enemies kinda stay the same as they scale with you and just walk around. There's also that the options for manual aiming don't work right, so you have to play it like a 1hand game, but I could live with that if the previous issue didn't exist. I'll keep playing it for a while, it's fun enough that I'll unlock everything, but I don't think I'll play after that. I guess if you don't mind a very chill game of this sort, you'd enjoy it for a while too.
